g.aria-label: Why Behavioral Accuracy & Heatmaps Alone Can Mislead
Attends sharply to offset j − i = −31
Mechanistic Lesson: Position Shortcut ≠ Content-Based Induction
A 1-block model with bias queries/keys under RoPE can hard-code a fixed offset −31,
but content-based in-context lookup [A][B]…[A] → [B] requires at least 2 layers!
